name: Fast
description: BS-RoFormer Resurrection Inst, the strongest single small instrumental model (SDR ~17.25 on the community leaderboard). One pass over the song. Already very clean; the quickest way to an instrumental.

name: Best quality
summary: Three top models, each run three times, averaged.
description: Three of the best instrumental models (Resurrection Inst, becruily Inst, Gabox FV7z). Each one runs three times: normal, left/right swapped, and polarity flipped (ZFTurbo's test-time augmentation). The nine results are averaged (UVR's Average ensemble): each model's random mistakes partly cancel out. Slowest, cleanest.

name: Keep backing vocals
summary: Removes the lead voice only; keeps the hook's backing voices and ad-libs.
description: karaoke-gen's two-step method. 1) Resurrection Inst makes a clean instrumental (three passes). 2) The voice it removed (song minus instrumental) goes through a karaoke model that splits lead from backing vocals. 3) The backing vocals are mixed back into the instrumental.
